_schema.description: PR-Y1.1 chord-recognition eval set — 20 CC-licensed tracks for genre-balanced accuracy measurement against KlangioChordSource (and future providers). Metadata ONLY — audio is downloaded on demand by apps/worker/tests/test_chord_eval.py into .chord-eval-cache/ (gitignored) when CHORD_EVAL_FETCH=1 is set.
_schema.verification_protocol: Before CHORD_EVAL_FETCH=1 is ever flipped on, every row with verification_status != 'verified' MUST be manually reviewed against its FMA/Jamendo/YT Audio Library license page. The staging verification lead flips verification_status to 'verified' and commits the update in a follow-up PR. This file is intentionally seeded with verification_status='pending' because the PR author cannot fetch external URLs during the build and would not hallucinate specific track IDs under the CC3-strict guard.
_schema.verification_log: PR-Y1.eval-verify (2026-11-04) performed a first WebFetch-based verification pass. Companion report: chord_eval_songs.verification.json. Summary: 4 verified, 1 replace_recommended, 15 pending. Pending rows retain last_check_at + last_check_note and MUST be re-verified in a follow-up before CHORD_EVAL_FETCH=1.
